newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed, gold up.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed, gold up.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious were expected to open mixed Tuesday, with gold called flat to higher, taking a breather from the almost $15 drop since last Thursday.
COMEX August gold was called flat to up $1.00 from Monday's close of $319.00 an ounce, a fresh 12-year low.
London bullion was fixed this morning at $317.60, down from $318.00 Monday afternoon. Bullion was quoted by dealers here at $319.00/90.
COMEX September silver was called 2.0 to 3.0 cents.
Tuesday, spot silver in London was fixed at $4.25, its lowest since Nov 3, 1993.
Although gold halted its slide overnight, dealers said they were still generally bearish and expecting the market to test $300.00 or below.
On ACCESS, August COMEX gold was up $0.70 at $319.70, with September silver off 4.0 cents at $4.245.
NYMEX October platinum was called to open off $1.00 to $3.00, with NYMEX September palladium called $1.00 to $2.00 weaker.
